subject: is Shiny able to display table data from a database?

messages.author: f9c5f1187ca3c5b6
messages.subject: is Shiny able to display table data from a database?
parts:
on my local Shiny, I am able to display some data which is retrieved from a local database.

library(lubridate)
library(RODBC)

library(RODBC)
myconn <- odbcConnect("MySQL_dsn", uid="tanthiamhuat", pwd="1234567890")

query2 <- paste("SELECT * FROM Punggol.PunggolCentral WHERE Customer = 'Chinese 1'")

result2 <- sqlQuery(myconn,query2)

# server.R
# --------------------------------------------------------
server <- shinyServer(function(input, output, session) {
  output$table <- renderDataTable(result2)
})

see printscreen.

but when I deploy, it always display "Disconnected from the server."  What are the issues?
